en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a fortified hilltop complex with towers and stone walls, seen from a sloping cobbled path. On the left are large medieval-looking buildings with conical roofs and battlements, likely part of a castle or fortress. On the right runs a high stone wall with a narrow path beside it, bordered by trees. In the foreground a woman and two children walk along the path. At the top in red Gothic-style print is the caption indicating the location and viewpoint.
